Platform Features

Atomic design system, multi-tenant via CSS variables, edge deployment, and automated content pipeline.

Edge Performance

Deployed on Cloudflare with static generation. Lightning-fast load times and global scalability.

Atomic Design System

Svelte 5 components with CVA, clsx and tailwind-merge. Brand-agnostic via CSS custom properties.

Native Multi-tenant

Each tenant overrides tokens in theme.css. Zero code duplication, maximum visual flexibility.

MDX + DAG Content

Pydantic pipeline: TOFU → MOFU → BOFU. Automated generation via directed graphs with LLM.

Knowledge Graph

FalkorDB for article-product-user relationships. BI, recommendations and GraphRAG optimization.

Dark Mode Native

Full prefers-color-scheme support. All components adapt automatically to dark mode.
